# Blueprint And Artifact Instructions

Use Specification-Driven Coding artifact discipline.

The Vertical Blueprint comes before final plan and tasks.

Every profile, blueprint, prompt, scorecard, or skill must reduce generic output and declare constraints, assumptions, non-goals, quality gates, and validation expectations.

Do not silently default to React, Next, Supabase, Firebase, RAG, microservices, or multi-agent architecture.

For targeted changes, use inspect-before-edit, probable cause, exact files, minimal patch, validation, and rollback.
